faqs.q: How do I apply for a learner driver licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a learner driver licence using the online service.

faqs.q: How can I take the Driver Knowledge Test (DKT)?
faqs.a: You can do the DKT online or book it in-person at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What resources are available for learning to drive?
faqs.a: You can download the Road User Handbook, use the learner driver log book app, and practice tests are available for the in-person DKT.
